package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner;

import java.time.LocalDate;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Out;
import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.mapper.OwnerMapper;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto.OwnerFieldsDto;
import org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.FutureRegistrationDateException;

public class BuildOwner {

    public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, Out<Owner> built)
            throws FutureRegistrationDateException {
        Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(request);
        // A newly created owner is not deleted.
        owner.setDeleted(false);
        LocalDate effective = owner.getRegistrationDate();
        if (effective == null) {
            effective = LocalDate.now();
        }
        // A supplied registration date cannot be in the future; reject a date later than the
        // server's current date with a 400 before it is rolled onto a business day.
        else if (effective.isAfter(LocalDate.now())) {
            throw new FutureRegistrationDateException(effective);
        }
        // The effective registration date must fall on a business day, whether supplied in the
        // request or defaulted to the server date; a weekend or public holiday rolls forward to the
        // next non-holiday business day.
        owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDays.rollForward(effective));
        built.set(owner);
    }
}

    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

          readOnly: true

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object

        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32

          example: 1

        name:

          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Drives the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and
            also returned: on return it is the composed address — the normalized 'addressLine1' with a
            single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
            An owner must supply an address in either form: a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address', plus 'city'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when present. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, upper-cased,
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. Normalized like
            'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and brackets and an
            optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by
            8 to 15 digits). A national number without a '+' assumes country code '+61' and drops a
            single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid for the city's
            region per the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional. When present, drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only override for create. The household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); when an
            existing owner shares this owner's lastName and postcode the request is rejected with 409,
            unless sharesHousehold is true, in which case the owner is created as a declared household
            member (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). Not persisted and not returned.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as 'title lastName' (the title, a single space, then
                the lastName) when a title is given, or just the lastName when no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), the REGION component of the customerCode
                ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'); 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode yields no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality (region), from the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane); null when the region is absent or unknown.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region
                code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, else 'UNKNOWN') and HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone + lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls in, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends. Null when registrationDate
                is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year the registrationDate falls in (fiscal year starting
                1 July).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over the normalized lastName and postcode. Owners with the same
                lastName and postcode resolve to the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3A7F9C2E1B0D'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key: the SHA-256 hex (lower-case, 64 characters) over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where email is the lower-cased
                email or empty. Duplicate detection is expressed entirely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c5920'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Zero when the
                owner's name was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for tenure of one or more
                elapsed fiscal years (fiscal year starting 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4, derived by banding membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3, level 3 for 4-5, level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, computed from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's business
                day at the moment it was created (a bulk sign-up); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already held between 40
                and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, an existing owner shared this
                owner's lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match that is
                still created rather than rejected); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate of, when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false. DELETE
                /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true) while retaining the record, and the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>' where id is the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology

- **`OwnerMapper`** — dropped `checkDigit` and `membershipNumber` mappings/methods; `memberId` auto-maps from the entity; `locality`/`timezone` read region off the memberId; `fiscalYear` now reads the FY segment out of the memberId (so it references the memberId).
- **`OwnerRegion`** — `regionOf`/`timezoneOf` parse the memberId prefix (via known-region matching) instead of the old dashed code; added `knownRegions()`.
- **`AuditOwnerCreated` / `OwnerCreatedEvent`** — the audit line and structured event now reference `memberId`; `primaryIdentifier` returns the memberId.
- **`openapi.yml`** — replaced the `customerCode`/`checkDigit`/`membershipNumber` schemas with a `memberId` schema; updated `locality`/`fiscalYear` descriptions. (The `OwnerDto` is generated from this at build time.)
- Refreshed javadoc in `OwnerIdentity` and `OwnerMembership`.

One thing worth flagging: I widened the DB column to `VARCHAR(24)` because the unified base id (`UNKNOWN` region + FY + HASH8 + CHK = 18 chars) plus a collision suffix is longer than the old `VARCHAR(20)`.
